raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The image displays three donut charts side by side, each representing different economic indicators for the sectors of industry, construction, trade, and other services in 2021, based on NACE Rev. 2 classification. The first chart, titled "NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES," shows the distribution of enterprises by sector: industry (8%, 2.4 million, gold color), construction (12%, 3.7 million, blue), trade (19%, 5.9 million, red), and other services (61%, 19.0 million, dark blue). The second chart, "NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED," presents employment figures: industry (21%, 33.0 million, gold), construction (9%, 13.4 million, blue), trade (19%, 29.5 million, red), and other services (51%, 80.2 million, dark blue). The third chart, "TURNOVER," illustrates net turnover: industry (33%, 10.6 trillion, gold), construction (6%, 1.9 trillion, blue), trade (31%, 9.9 trillion, red), and other services (31%, 9.8 trillion, dark blue). All charts use the same color scheme for sectors as indicated in the legend at the bottom: gold for industry, blue for construction, red for trade, and dark blue for other services. Each segment is labeled with its percentage and absolute value. The sectors are visually arranged in clockwise order starting from the top right in each chart, with no segments pulled out or emphasized. There is no additional legend beyond the color-coded key, and all percentage and absolute value labels are placed directly within or adjacent to the respective segments.
